items.title: Russian refineries representing 30% of nameplate capacity affected by drone strikes
items.summary: Reuters reported that attacks since late October have disrupted nine major Russian refineries whose combined nameplate capacity represents about 30% of national capacity. This is not a confirmed 30% fall in throughput: industry sources estimate an actual possible crude-processing reduction of up to 200,000 tonnes per day. Repair progress and fuel exports will determine the lasting physical impact.

observations.value: 9 of Russia's 35 largest

observations.value: Approximately 300,000 metric tonnes per day (~2.2 million barrels per day); around 30% of national nameplate

observations.label: Potential actual crude-processing shortfall
observations.value: Up to 200,000 metric tonnes per day (~1.47 million barrels per day), industry-source estimate; not verified measured loss

observations.label: Independent market-price response
observations.value: No Russia-specific Brent, WTI, XLE or XOP effect isolated

items.key_finding: Widespread refinery operating disruptions are reported, but capacity affected must not be confused with verified lost production.

items.title: UKMTO Warning 202-26 flags another unresolved Hormuz tanker incident
items.summary: Reports of UKMTO Warning 202-26 describe suspicious activity involving a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, with military authorities as the source. The vessel, incident date and time, crew condition, damage and environmental effects are unknown. This is a separate warning from 201-26, but it is neither a confirmed attack nor a verified physical oil-flow loss.

items.title: Talen Energy secures seven-year 750 MW PJM capacity contract with expected $100M annual revenue
items.summary: Talen Energy announced a seven-year agreement covering 750 MW of accredited capacity at Guernsey Power Station, expected to generate approximately $100 million a year beginning in the 2029/30 PJM delivery year. Combined with existing capacity arrangements, these megawatts provide about $1 billion of ten-year capacity-revenue visibility. TLN advanced in morning trading; PJM rules, delivery obligations and operations remain risks.

items.title: AI memory, storage and optical networking shares rebound broadly after CoreWeave outlook
items.summary: CoreWeave's strong third-quarter results and customer-backed financing narrative triggered a broad recovery across previously battered AI hardware suppliers. Reports published around 9:03-9:08 AM EST showed Sandisk, Seagate, Micron, Coherent and Lumentum up roughly 7-9%, with CoreWeave up about 17% premarket. The move suggests renewed confidence in infrastructure demand but does not confirm durable financing or price recovery.

items.title: Siemens Energy records EUR164bn backlog and lifts power-equipment growth outlook
items.summary: Siemens Energy reported a record €164 billion order backlog, approximately €15 billion of it linked to data centers. It targets 14–16% comparable revenue growth and a 14–16% operating margin before special items in FY2027. Shares rose roughly 7–8% in early European trading; revenue conversion, costs, and an earnings forecast below consensus remain risks.
